definition: ἐκ-φέρω  [in LXX chiefly for יָצָא hi. ;] __1. to carry out, bring out: with accusative of thing(s), Luk.15:22, 1Ti.6:7; with accusative of person(s), Mrk.8:23, Act.5:15; of the dead for burial (cf. κομίζω), Act.5:6, 9-10.  __2. to bring forth;  __(a) of women (Hipp., Arist., al.);  __(b) of the ground (Hdt.): Heb.6:8.† (AS)
